title: Burnisher roofline row
description: One published cell. The ceiling columns are ARITHMETIC and say so; the achieved and floor columns are measurements and are null until a run produces them. The whole point of the schema is that those two kinds of number can never be confused for one another.

ceiling_basis.description: Computed from a config file and a device peak. No run produced it, and it is never evidence about a speedup.

peak_basis.description: Where the device peak behind the ceiling came from. Anything but `measured` means every achieved fraction computed against it is a LOWER bound on how done the cell really is.

achieved.description: MEASURED. Null means nobody has measured this cell -- which is a statement, not a gap to be filled with a plausible figure.
